user_clarification: Five-minute checks are health checks, not cutoffs. If a sibling is still reasoning or the lane may simply be slow, wait longer rather than diminishing the response.

policy.retry_condition: retry only after distinct stale/freshness evidence, such as no marker, composer available, no active generation, and no text growth or explicit route blocker

implementation_notes: For Browser/Lumen lanes, prefer marker-count checks and active-generation checks without extracting raw response text.
If the first five-minute check has no marker but generation is active or may still be progressing, continue waiting in bounded intervals.
Do not issue a duplicate prompt while a response is plausibly still forming.
If a duplicate retry was already sent because a lane appeared stale, record the event status-only and avoid publishing raw transcript text.
Apply the same non-diminishing wait policy to CLI and app sibling lanes.
